description: The Southern African Development Community (SADC) Secretariat in Gaborone publishes a statistics database as annual yearbook workbooks. The database page lists statistics on population, health, education, national accounts, prices, the external sector, money and banking, foreign direct investment, agriculture, environment, tourism, transport, energy, water, ICT and mining, and offers them as three workbooks per year: Demography and Social, Sectors and Macroeconomic. The infrastructure topics sit in the Sectors workbook, available for 2022, 2023 and 2024 (the 2024 file is about 4.8 MB), with an older 2015 yearbook. Coverage: the SADC member states; the member list and the years inside each workbook were not read. Format and access: Excel workbooks (XLSX) downloaded from the SADC statistics database page, alongside macroeconomic bulletins, policy frameworks and technical documents; free. SADC also points to a data portal on the Open Data for Africa platform, which answered the cloud with a Cloudflare check and was not read. Licence: not read. Caveats: the workbooks were not opened, so the indicators behind the transport, energy, water and ICT headings were not checked. Simulation uses: national infrastructure and service statistics for Southern African states, such as energy and water supply and transport volumes, to set baselines in regional scenarios. Related records: the World Bank Africa Infrastructure Country Diagnostic (data-world-bank-africa-infrastructure-country-diagnostic) covers African infrastructure at country level.
